items.title: HPQ earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- HP Inc (HPQ) reported FY2026 Q4 on Nov 24, 2026. The stock was trading at $30.90 (+10.58%) as of Nov 25, 3:08 PM EST. That reaction is the surprise. Coverage on the evening of the print was titled "stock slips" and "cautious 2027 outlook hits stock". The shares then reversed sharply higher during the next session. Possible reasons are a guide that was already priced in, and a stock that had fallen 8% over the prior month.
